title: Hotel Finance UK
summary: Hotel Finance is listed under Silver Oak Capital's Commercial services. Search [b] confirmed the page exists with the listing title 'Hotel Finance UK' and revealed its core framing: hotel finance is commercial lending secured against a hotel or guest house; repayment depends on trading profit rather than tenant rent; lenders often size the maximum loan as a multiple of adjusted net profit (EBITDA); typical hotel LTVs are 60% to 70%. The rest of what the searches surfaced about hotel lending comes from other silveroakcapital.co.uk pages (FAQ, homepage, whole-loans page, Cap Ferrat case study), not from the hotel-finance page itself. The actual H1, meta description, section headings, calls to action and any fee/rate/term wording on the page were NOT revealed. Search [c] returned only unrelated third-party hotel-lending articles and nothing about Silver Oak.
